summary: Syncing collections needs a subscription, org admin on console.redhat.com, a requirements file, allowlisted domains (galaxy.ansible.com, cloud.redhat.com, console.redhat.com, sso.redhat.com, ansible-galaxy-ng S3, automation-hub-prd.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com, ansible-galaxy.s3.amazonaws.com) and no SSL inspection; hub does not resolve dependencies from other repositories, so disable dependency download.
questions: Which domains must be allowlisted to sync automation hub content?
Why does collection sync fail on dependencies?
Does SSL inspection break automation hub sync?
What are the prerequisites for syncing collections?

answer_card.title: Firewall allowlist for hub content sync
answer_card.answer_md:
Allow:
- `galaxy.ansible.com`, `cloud.redhat.com`, `console.redhat.com`, `sso.redhat.com`
- `ansible-galaxy-ng.s3.dualstack.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`
- `automation-hub-prd.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com`
- `ansible-galaxy.s3.amazonaws.com`

Disable SSL inspection for these Red Hat domains. Hub does not fetch dependencies from other repos, so turn off dependency download on the remote to avoid errors.
